item.create_universal.space_helmet.toolt: Helmet of the _space suit_. With all four pieces on you can survive in a _vacuum_.
You breathe the air in the _chestplate_. Without a suit, a vacuum _suffocates_ you.
item.create_universal.space_chestplate.t: Chestplate of the _space suit_: it is also its _air tank_.
item.create_universal.space_suit_tank.to: Chestplate of the _space suit_ and its _air tank_. It can be _placed_ as a block.
_Refills_ with air, but only where there is air: _Earth_ or an _oxygen_ room.
item.create_universal.space_visor.toolti: Suit helmet component. Combine it with a _netherite helmet_ and a _netherite diving helmet_ using a _Deployer_.
item.create_universal.pressure_seals.too: Suit leggings component. Combine it with _netherite leggings_ using a _Deployer_.
item.create_universal.thermal_insulation: _Suit upgrade_ against _extreme cold_ (Mars, Titan, the icy moons...).
The suit piece is protected from the cold.
item.create_universal.radiation_shield.t: _Suit upgrade_ against _radiation_ (Jupiter's moons, Mercury, near the Sun).
The suit piece is protected from radiation.
item.create_universal.cooling_system.too: _Suit upgrade_ against _extreme heat_ (Mercury by day, Io's volcanoes).
The suit piece is protected from heat.
item.create_universal.venus_plating.tool: _Suit upgrade_ against the _pressure_ and _acid_ of _Venus_: the final challenge.
item.create_universal.tank_expansion.too: Applied to the chestplate with a Deployer
item.create_universal.aerogel.tooltip.su: An ultralight material that _insulates from cold_. Used for the suit's _thermal insulation_.
item.create_universal.chromium_superallo: An alloy that _withstands heat_. Used for the suit's _cooling system_.
item.create_universal.chromium_ingot.too: Comes from _chromite_. Used for the _chromium superalloy_.
item.create_universal.boron_ingot.toolti: Comes from _colemanite_. With _beryllium_, used for the _radiation shield_.
item.create_universal.beryllium_ingot.to: Comes from _beryl_. With _boron_, used for the _radiation shield_.
block.create_universal.orbital_stabilize: Holds the ship _fixed in place_ in space: its body doesn't drag it and it doesn't orbit.
With 128 RPM and a redstone signal
The ship stays _still_ where it was, facing the same way. It shows on the _map_ as a parked ship.
The ship gets back the speed of the body whose zone it is in.
block.create_universal.gravity_stabilize: Gives _gravity_ inside a closed room, towards the face it is attached to.
With 128 RPM in a closed room
Everything inside falls towards the block, even if the ship turns.
Changes the _strength_, from 5 to 150 % of Earth's.
block.create_universal.map_table.tooltip: A table with the _solar system map_ drawn on top.
They make a bigger table (up to 24×24) with a bigger map.
Opens the _map_: bodies, markers, debris, parked ships and _destination_.
block.create_universal.holo_projector.to: Projects the _solar system in 3D_ above the block.
block.create_universal.ship_assistant.to: The _brain_ of the ship: it checks it, shows a _panel_ to everyone aboard and has an _autopilot_.
Counts its _thrusters_, _fuel_, energy, hull and air.
Can _turn_ the ship and fly it to the _map destination_ by itself, taking off if needed.
Opens its screen: engines, "Others", top speed, go to destination and explore.
Hides or shows the top panel.
item.create_universal.assistant_core.too: The heart of the _Ship Assistant_ and the _Cruise Drive_. Made by _sequenced assembly_.
block.create_universal.cruise_drive.tool: For _long trips_: far from everything, the ship's thrusters push _×4_.
With 128 RPM, in space, far from bodies and rocks
The ship's Create Propulsion thrusters push _four times_ harder.
Near a body or a rock field
block.create_universal.asteroid_rock.too: A rock from the _asteroid belt_. It can't be broken.
Hit with a diamond pickaxe or better
Drops a _fragment_ (5 per rock; refills in 5 minutes).
Ice from the _rings of Saturn_. It can't be broken.
Hit with a diamond pickaxe or better
Drops a _fragment_ (5 per rock; refills in 5 minutes).
block.create_universal.asteroid_belt_fra: A piece of _the asteroid belt_, mined from one of its rocks. It can be _placed_.
block.create_universal.saturn_ring_fragm: A piece of _the rings of Saturn_, mined from one of its rocks. It can be _placed_.
block.create_universal.phobos_fragment.t: A piece of _Phobos_, mined from one of its rocks. It can be _placed_.
block.create_universal.deimos_fragment.t: A piece of _Deimos_, mined from one of its rocks. It can be _placed_.
block.create_universal.space_suit_tank.t: Chestplate of the _space suit_ and its _air tank_. It can be _placed_ as a block.
_Refills_ with air, but only where there is air: _Earth_ or an _oxygen_ room.
create_universal.ponder.ship_assistant.t: Placed on a ship, the Ship Assistant checks it every second: thrusters, fuel, energy, hull and air
Its gyroscope needs at least 64 RPM: with it, the assistant can turn the whole ship
Right-click it to see the ship, set the top speed, fly to the map destination or explore
The autopilot drives Create Propulsion thrusters. Touching their controls turns it off
Its redstone output is the autopilot power: use it for engines it doesn't know (the "Others" list)
create_universal.ponder.map_table.text_1: The Map Table shows the solar system map on top
create_universal.ponder.map_table.text_2: Right-click it to open the map: bodies, markers, debris, parked ships and your destination
create_universal.ponder.map_table.text_3: Tables placed in a square (up to 24x24) join into one big map
create_universal.ponder.holo_projector.t: The Holographic Projector shows the solar system in 3D above it
Right-click it to open the map
Shift + right-click changes its size, its view (map, whole system or around you) and the names
create_universal.ponder.gravity_stabiliz: The Gravity Stabilizer sticks to a face: gravity pulls towards that face. On a ship, it goes on the floor
It needs at least 128 RPM, from behind, and only works inside a closed room
Scroll on it to set the strength, from 5 to 150 % of Earth's gravity
create_universal.ponder.cruise_drive.tex: The Cruise Drive is for long trips. It needs at least 128 RPM and a lot of stress
In space, far from bodies and rock fields, the ship's thrusters push four times harder
Near a planet, a moon or a rock field it stands by on its own: brake in time!
The space suit chestplate is also its air tank, and it can be placed as a block
With rotation from above it refills, like Create's backtank...
...but only where there is air: on Earth or in a room with oxygen
